case.summary: The alert was triggered when the real-time model scored transaction 3450629, an online purchase of $100.09 on card C04570-K1, with a risk score of 0.57. The strongest findings are that a model risk score of 0.57 for product R transactions corresponds to a calibrated fraud rate of 5 % based on historical data, and that repeated same-amount R purchases in quick succession are a known habit of this cardholder, with an identical $99.96 purchase recorded earlier on the same day. The case was judged legitimate with a fraud probability of 0.04. The recommended actions are to allow the transaction and close the case with no fraud finding.
